deviations: Probabilistic-incentive and product-position controls are coded as the AMT wave-2 randomized design variation (incentiveshigh, incentiveleft, incentiveshigh_incentiveleft); the professionals' always-probabilistic scheme is absorbed by their treatment indicator. The first scored run (attempt-4) used probabilistic_incentive (which is 1 for all professionals) and gave a Choice Free-Professionals coefficient of -0.022; the change was made after comparing with the claimed -0.095.
Selfishness uses the dataset's stdalpha (standardized MPL count) as provided; HC3 SEs via sandwich::vcovHC on lm.
notes: Data: Data/Clean Data/choice_experiments.dta only. Sample: the four main Choice treatments (Table 1): AMT Choice Free (waves 1-3, low/standard and wave-2 probabilistic incentives; the 10-fold and 100-fold High Stakes arms dropped), Incentive First Costly (waves 1 and 3), Quality First Costly, plus 712 professionals; AMT advisors kept only with a consistent MPL (non-missing selfishness), which reproduces Table 1 Ns 2,574/1,562/1,067/712; dropping 7 advisors with missing age gives N=5,908 (5,196 AMT). Outcomes: choicebefore (prefer incentive first) for Table 2, recommendincentive for Table 3; controls female, age, AMT-2/AMT-3 wave dummies, probabilistic, position and their interaction. Table 3 splits on getyourchoice; column 3 adds notgetyourchoice and its interactions with choicebefore and noconflict. All Table 2/3 targets reproduce to 3 decimals except Choice Free-Professionals (-0.084 vs -0.095); Table 3 professionals coefficients (not claimed) also differ somewhat, suggesting the authors' exact coding of the probabilistic/position controls differs slightly. Attempts 1-3 were exploratory (variable inspection, sample counts). Runs were run in a scratch directory and copied here. No hangs.
